fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: {"value":"System-generated unique record identifier for each feature.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: Event_Number
fields.description: {"value":"Police event number assigned to the call for service record.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: Complaint_Number
fields.description: {"value":"Complaint or case number associated with the call for service.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: Tencode
fields.description: {"value":"Numeric call type code used by Metro Nashville Police Department.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Tencode_Description
fields.description: {"value":"Text description of the Tencode call type.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Tencode_Suffix
fields.description: {"value":"Code suffix that further qualifies the Tencode call type.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Tencode_Suffix_Description
fields.description: {"value":"Text description of the Tencode suffix.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Disposition_Code
fields.description: {"value":"Code describing the outcome or handling of the call.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Disposition_Description
fields.description: {"value":"Text description of the call disposition or outcome.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Block
fields.description: {"value":"Street block number associated with the call location.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: Street_Name
fields.description: {"value":"Street name associated with the call location.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: Unit_Dispatched
fields.description: {"value":"Police unit dispatched to the call for service.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: Shift
fields.description: {"value":"Police shift during which the call was handled.","fieldValueType":"orderedOrRanked"}

fields.name: Sector
fields.description: {"value":"Police sector associated with the call location.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Mapped_Location
fields.description: {"value":"Geocoded or mapped location for the call.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: POINT_X
fields.description: {"value":"Longitude coordinate of the call location.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: POINT_Y
fields.description: {"value":"Latitude coordinate of the call location.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: ZONE_
fields.description: {"value":"Police zone associated with the call location.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: {"value":"Latitude coordinate of the call location.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: {"value":"Longitude coordinate of the call location.","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: RPA
fields.description: {"value":"Response patrol area or related patrol assignment identifier.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: Call_Received
fields.description: {"value":"Date and time the call for service was received by the Emergency Communications Center.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}
